definitions.explanation: A security inspection of passengers and their belongings, typically at airports before boarding, to ensure safety. Also used for security inspections at other facilities.

examples.japanese: {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}を{通|とお}った。
examples.english: I passed through the security check.

examples.japanese: {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}{場|じょう}は{混雑|こんざつ}していた。
examples.english: The security screening area was crowded.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}の1{時間前|じかんまえ}までに{保安検査|ほあんけんさ}を{済|す}ませてください。
examples.english: Please complete the security screening at least one hour before departure.

notes:
Most commonly used in the context of airport security screening. At Japanese airports, signs and announcements use {保安検査|ほあんけんさ} as the standard term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}{場|じょう} — security screening area
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}を{受|う}ける — to undergo a security check
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}を{済|す}ませる — to complete security screening
- {保安検査|ほあんけんさ}{締|し}め{切|き}り — security screening cutoff time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手荷物検査|てにもつけんさ} — baggage inspection
- {身体検査|しんたいけんさ} — body search, physical examination
- セキュリティチェック — security check (loanword, less formal)
